# CourseOps 21 synthetic benchmark

This fixture is a local-only, provider-neutral screen-operation benchmark. John
Brown is an invented persona. Every assessment and certificate is synthetic and
has no employment, regulatory, or qualification value.

The fixture intentionally requires visible lesson reading, scrolling, explicit
pointer selection, submission, certificate download, and return-to-inbox loops.
The final marker appears only after all 21 local certificates have been generated.

Automation of assessment screens is valid only when the separate signed
`SyntheticAssessmentGrant` is active for the exact loopback origin, asset tree,
browser process, window binding, run, and action sequence. The exception never
extends to CAPTCHA, MFA, identity, attestation, authorization, or a remote site.
